description: Extract all current-level raw Upgrade Vault quotes from the native catalog

extractions.label: vault_upgrade_costs
extractions.expression: idleon.getAttr("CustomLists").h.UpgradeVault.map((upgrade, index) => ({ index, level: Number(idleon.getAttr("UpgVault")[index]), maxLevel: idleon.callFunction("Summoning", "VaultUpgMaxLV", index, 0), cost: idleon.callFunction("Summoning", "VaultUpgCost", index, 0) }))
extractions.description: Complete native catalog of raw quotes at genuine saved levels. VaultUpgCost does not apply the purchase cap gate; capped upgrades can retain nonzero quotes.
